## Executive Summary
High-impact Full-Stack Software & Systems Engineer with 2.5+ years of production experience architecting concurrent backends (Java 21 Spring Boot, Rust 2024 Axum), reactive cross-platform applications (React 19/TypeScript, Flutter BLoC), and hardware-level IoT integrations. Proven track record in building enterprise ERP/HRMS suites, smart parking architectures, and native protocol handlers (ZKTeco ADMS, Frigate AI NVR, RTSP CCTV).

## Core Technical Competencies & Technical Arsenal
1. **Systems & Concurrency:**
   - Rust 2024 (Tokio Async, Axum 0.8)
   - Java 21 LTS (Spring Boot 3.4 / 4.x, Project Loom Virtual Threads)
   - C / Low-Level Sockets, POSIX Threads, Epoll Zero-Copy Networking
   - Multi-threaded Daemons, mpsc channels

2. **Databases & Storage:**
   - PostgreSQL 16 (SeaORM Async Connection Pools, 32/32 worker pools)
   - Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, ACID Transactions, JPA Criteria Specifications
   - Redis Pub/Sub, In-Memory Caching & Clustering
   - SQLite Embedded WAL mode for edge persistence

3. **Hardware & IoT Protocols:**
   - ZKTeco ADMS (HTTP Push Protocol communication daemon)
   - RTSP / H.264 Video Stream processing with Frigate AI NVR
   - RS485 / RS232 Serial loopback control
   - GPIO Relay Barrier Automation with watchdog fail-safe latch
   - Barcode Multi-Terminal Real-Time Sync

4. **Frontend & DevOps:**
   - React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Astro 5
   - Three.js, React Three Fiber (3D visualizers)

## Production Engineered Systems
1. **PMS-V2 Smart Parking Engine:**
   - Autonomous edge-to-cloud vehicle access automation.
   - Low-latency barrier relay control with <0.84ms OCR plate recognition trigger.
   - 8 In / 8 Out zero-drop multi-lane state machine running on Tokio & Axum.
   - Second-by-second tariff computation with SeaORM transactional ledger in PostgreSQL.

2. **Enterprise Skylink HRMS Suite:**
   - High-throughput biometric protocol daemon handling raw HTTP push payloads from dozens of ZKTeco attendance terminals.
   - Java 21 Project Loom virtual thread pool handling non-blocking employee attendance punches.
   - EXIF metadata analyzer extracting GPS coordinates and WebSocket dashboard telemetry.

3. **Workstation Activity Monitor:**
   - Lightweight enterprise background Chrome MV3 service worker capturing focus drift and system telemetry.
   - Local hardware cryptography using AES-256 GCM offline IndexedDB buffer queue.
   - < 14MB resident memory impact and < 0.01% background CPU usage.
